newsitem.title: USA: Burger King to promote Jurassic Park sequel.
newsitem.headline: Burger King to promote Jurassic Park sequel.

text.p: Burger King Corp, a unit of Grand Metropolitan Plc, said it signed an agreement with Universal Studios to offer promotional products tied to the 1997 release of Steven Spielberg's sequel to "Jurassic Park," the highest grossing film of all time.
The sequel, "The Lost World: Jurassic Park," is to be directed by Spielberg and based on the best-selling novel written by Michael Crichton.
Burger King said it will offer toys and other premiums based on characters from the sequel to the popular 1993 movie which has earned $913 million in worldwide box office receipts since its release.

"With an extremely healthy business and demand for our brand at an all-time high, Burger King Corp is in a unique position to align ourselves with premier entertainment properties," said Burger King marketing vice president Paul Clayton.

Earlier this year, Burger King lost out to McDonald's Corp in winning a multi-year deal with Disney for childrens' meal promotions tied to Disney movies. In fiscal 1995, Burger King had systemwide sales of $8.4 billion.
